new_external_requests_scope: No new external source requests or original acquisitions in r39. Manitoba, WSA and Cumberland originals were retained from earlier work. Receipt statuses and timestamps describe those successful earlier acquisitions. The independent reviewer made zero external requests.
source_group_definition: Three official publisher organizations: Manitoba Geological Survey, Saskatchewan Water Security Agency and Elections Saskatchewan. Organization count does not establish independent underlying hydrographic datasets. Manitoba provides the partial Loon association and WSA the partial Primrose association; Cumberland provides context only.
registration_limit: All 120 WSA, 30 Cumberland and 34 Manitoba ordered position registrations were independently recomputed using full original embedded affines. Every selected position falls inside its inspected crop, but this does not establish map coverage: the Alberta-side Primrose tip is unmapped. Both sides of the Saskatchewan-Manitoba ring are covered by complementary maps; exact naming partitions remain unresolved.

observations.own_observations: The first selected ring follows east-west water beside the Stanley Mission settlement, with no established selected-water name. WSA shows the western arm of the second cross-border ring without a water-name label. Original WSA pixels clearly label Primrose Lake in the rounded main Saskatchewan basin followed by the complete 56-position ring. The visible southwest arm is also compared, but the far southwest tip extends into blank Alberta map space. All geometry is inspected, yet original naming evidence does not cover it all. Partial Primrose association with source-material pending; whole-feature identity review remains incomplete.
